name: San Juan River
gaugeName: San Juan River near Bluff, UT
blurb: Sand Island to Mexican Hat (Upper San Juan) and the Goosenecks / Mexican Hat to Clay Hills (Lower San Juan). BLM permit required year-round.

sections.notes: BLM permit required year-round (recreation.gov lottery). BLM trip planner: 27 miles, typically 2-3 days; river has class II to III rapids. River left (south) is Navajo Nation - separate permit to camp/hike. Do not leave vehicles overnight at Mexican Hat (break-ins).

guideTimes.conditions: BLM typical trip-length guidance. Includes overnight itinerary planning; actual time varies with conditions, camps and permit requirements.
guideTimes.sourceName: BLM San Juan Trip Planning Information

sections.notes: BLM: 57 miles, typically 4-5 days; Government Rapid often requires scouting. Clay Hills is the only viable take-out; BLM warns of a dangerous waterfall downstream of Clay Hills - do not miss the take-out. CR 278 to Clay Hills can be impassable when wet.
